prior_exposure_limitation: Wider model-family/project familiarity cannot be erased. No prior Evelyn-specific comprehensive ChatGPT/GrokBot/reconciliation/candidate-ranking/author-decision opinions opened during neutral Stage A.
official_legality_scope: Historical October14 exact-source 100-card Oracle/UBR Commander legality PASS; selective Evelyn/Ripples/Brainstorm/Party Thrasher current text checks only, no new 100-name Oracle sweep.
identity: Flash Evelyn as Worldgorger blink/reentry collection-counter exile access and cEDH combo outlet, backed by Breach and Thoracle/Consultation redundancies
natural_ceiling_hypothesis: Bracket 5 cEDH, no measured multiplayer win rate

primary_hypothesis.expected_gain: One-blue instant-speed card selection and fetchland shuffle resilience instead of two-mana enchantment with delayed first-main-phase milling and recurring life/tempo costs.
primary_hypothesis.strongest_counterargument: Ripples actively mills Worldgorger/Breach resources and conditionally recovers useful cards each future turn; Brainstorm cannot discard Dragon and can trap draws without a shuffle, risking off-theme generic cEDH homogenization.

important_rules: Evelyn {2}{U/B}{B}{B/R} has flash and is a Vampire Rogue; collection ability exiles one top card of each player for every controlled Vampire entrance.
Collection counter exiled card permission is once each turn while Evelyn on battlefield, with normal spell/land timing; mana-as-any-color is a payment allowance, not automatic free casting.
Worldgorger plus returning reanimation Aura can repeat ETB/LTB and blink Evelyn; requires exact stack sequence and available break/outlet to avoid a draw.
Thassa's Oracle plus Consultation/Pact requires legal timing and actual empty library; approved 100 has no duplicate names for Tainted Pact.
Breach escape consumes three other graveyard cards for every escape plus mana, not blanket free graveyard casting.
Ripples of Undeath begins triggering in first main phase after it survives to one; optional 1 generic +3 life picks among milled three. Brainstorm instant draws3 puts2 back.
